rows.name: Postman
rows.reason: Its API development and testing tools do not provide the hosted outbound email delivery required by this project.

rows.name: Postmark
rows.reason: REST/delivery diagnostics: $15/month for 10,000; free 100/month insufficient for thousands; Basic overages $1.80/1,000. Documents 45-day activity/analytics; superior-deliverability claims not independently validated.

rows.name: Resend
rows.reason: API/SDK free tier requires both 3,000/month and 100/day caps. Pro $20/month for 50,000 may be costly. Verify sender domain; noncommercial status does not establish nonprofit-discount eligibility.

rows.name: Zoho ZeptoMail / current Zoho CPaaS email service
rows.reason: Zoho six-month email credits may suit irregular traffic. CPaaS redirects prevent current-price verification; indexed ZeptoMail amounts are not current quotes. Confirm account/product terms; missing pricing is uncertainty, not disqualification.

rows.name: Postmark
rows.reason: Hosted transactional email APIs, delivery reporting, and a documented 10,000-email paid tier match thousands of notifications without operating an SMTP server.

rows.name: Postman
rows.reason: API engineering/testing can call an email provider, but still requires choosing that delivery provider. Whole-provider mismatch; no SMTP restriction or inability to call email APIs is asserted.

rows.name: MailEnable Standard self-administered SMTP server
rows.reason: Requires installing and administering a Windows mail server with SMTP services, directly conflicting with the requirement to avoid hosting or configuring a custom SMTP server.

rows.name: Amazon Simple Email Service (SES)
rows.reason: SES API sending costs $0.10/1,000 before extras. Requires AWS permissions, identity verification and production approval; sandbox restricts recipients. Verify plan/charges; project approval untested. No custom SMTP needed.

rows.name: Brevo transactional email API
rows.reason: Brevo's hosted transactional API offers 300 free emails daily without rollover. Limited overflow retries may leave messages undelivered, making large one-day bursts unsuitable despite the larger allowance than Resend.

rows.name: Postmark
rows.reason: Hosted HTTPS token-authenticated sending API avoids operating custom SMTP. Documented paid tier: $15/month for 10,000 emails. Independent deliverability testing and project-specific account approval were not performed.

rows.name: Resend
rows.reason: Hosted API/SDK supports modest free volume, capped at 100/day despite 3,000/month. Concentrated batches exceeding that daily cap need a paid plan and verified domain.

rows.name: Amazon Simple Email Service (SES)
rows.reason: Low-cost hosted notification API needs no operated SMTP server. Production access/sender verification add setup; attachments/optional services cost extra. Current pricing includes a post-cutoff plan change.

rows.name: SMTP2GO
rows.reason: Hosted HTTP sending API with reporting and a small paid batch tier. Pricing conflicts: body lists $10/10,000 monthly, title starts at $15; verify applicable pricing.

rows.name: Brevo
rows.reason: Transactional API: free 300/day; $9/month Starter begins 5,000/month with contact allowances. Configure sender/domain/API credentials. Free requires daily fit; reliability comparison and account approval unperformed.

rows.name: Postmark
rows.reason: Hosted REST API with history/delivery diagnostics may aid troubleshooting. Retrieved meaningful paid minimum is $15 for 10,000 monthly; 100-email free tier is too small for this use.

rows.name: MailerSend nonprofit program
rows.reason: MailerSend offers a hosted email API and potential nonprofit discount. Noncommercial status alone does not establish eligibility; proof and approval are required, with plan-specific limits.

rows.name: MailEnable Standard self-administered SMTP server
rows.reason: Self-administered MailEnable Standard requires operating mail services and configuring SMTP connectors. Both conflict with the prohibition on hosting/configuring a custom SMTP server; free pricing does not offset them.

rows.name: Zoho ZeptoMail / Zoho CPaaS email API
rows.reason: Zoho's credit-based email API may suit intermittent sending without recurring volume subscriptions. URLs redirect to CPaaS; credits expire in six months. Retrieved page exposed neither price nor rebrand date.
